title: Mexican Stew with Cabbage and German Sausage
description: A hearty and flavorful Mexican stew made with German sausage, cabbage, and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: German sausage (Mexican-style chorizo)
ingredients.notes: Slice the sausage into thick rounds

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, stew, cumin, and chili powder. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Serve with warm tortillas, if desired.
